newsitem.title: USA: Smithfield Foods see Q4 EPS about $1.00.
newsitem.headline: Smithfield Foods see Q4 EPS about $1.00.

text.p: Smithfield Foods Inc said on Wednesday that earnings for its fourth quarter ended April 27, 1997, should be about $1.00 per share and for the year end it expects earnings per share of about $2.30.
The company said despite its first quarter traditionally being its most difficult and unpredictable, it expects earnings to improve substantially over the same period last year.
Smithfield said hundreds of millions of dollars invested in long-term capital projects over the last several years are finally beginning to have a positive impact on its bottom line.
Over the next several years it will focus on superior hog genetics, vertical integration, processed meats and its international business.
